messages.scheduleHint: Schedule changes require a server restart to take effect. Enabling/disabling works immediately.

weeklyDigest.title: Weekly digest
weeklyDigest.desc: Collects new content from the last 7 days plus upcoming events. Only sent if there is content for the subscriber.

scheduledNewsletter.title: Scheduled newsletters
scheduledNewsletter.desc: Checks for newsletters with "Scheduled" status and sends them at their planned time.

eventBatch.title: Reactive notifications
eventBatch.desc: When new content is published, an event is queued. Once per day a single "What's new in Pensa Club" email is sent.

monthlyReport.title: Monthly report
monthlyReport.desc: At the start of each month, a summary email is sent with stats, top N seminars/articles/courses and upcoming items.
